title: 18 Sep, zone Z1, a $2,800 account: the leverage twin of 6.8
why: At 4,367.20 and 1:1.5 a minimum lot needs $4,367.20 x 100 x 0.01 / 1.5 = $2,911.47 of equity. With $2,800 the risk limit would allow about 0.025 lot but the leverage limit allows only 0.0096, which rounds down to nothing. This is the leverage-caused shortfall that 6.8 did not cover (plan finding F7, decision D4): it is shown as a fact, with Decline; raising the risk or choosing a nearer stop cannot help, and the report never suggests more leverage or another equity.
